issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the word 'của' (of) or a possessive structure for 'lời chứng' (the testimony). The Greek specifies 'του λόγου της μαρτυρίας αυτών' (the word of the testimony of them/their), whereas the Vietnamese 'nhờ lời chứng của mình' simplifies this to 'thanks to their testimony'.
